Package org.portico.utils.messaging

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    IMessageHandler
    A message handler is designed to consume and process PorticoMessage subclass objects, performing any appropraite actions (whether that be doing nothing, tranforming the message somehow, taking some action with the information contained within the message, filling out a ResponseMessage, etc...).
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AbstractMessageHandler
    This class is an empty implementation that provides support for automatically handling the recording of a handler name, augmentable status and priority.
    ErrorResponse
    This class represents an error response to a PorticoMessage.
    ExtendedSuccessMessage
    This class represents a success response message and can contain any number of return values that should be passed back to the initiator of the request.
    HandlerRegistry
    The HandlerRegistry exists to simplify the process of locating and loading handlers.
    MessageChain
    The MessageChain class provides a simple implementation of a chain-like structure, linking together a number of handlers into a single, logical handler.
    MessageContext
    A MessageContext aggregates together a PorticoMessage and a ResponseMessage into a single logical unit that can be passed around the various messaging framework components.
    MessageSink
    A MessageSink provides a super-structure for message processing.
    Module
    A Module collects together IMessageHandler classes so that they can be stored as a single unit and applied to a MessageSink or group of sinks as a single unit.
    PorticoMessage
    This is the parent class of all Portico request messages.
    ResponseMessage
    For each Request that is sent, a response is needed.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    MessageSink.Global
    Enum outlinging the possible chains a glocal handler can be added to.
  • Exception Summary 
    Exception Description
    MessagingException
    The generic exception used in the Messaging framework
    VetoException
    This exception should be thrown when a handlers wants to explicitly end any further processing of a message.
  • Annotation Types Summary 
    Annotation Type Description
    MessageHandler
    This annotation outlines the configuration data needed for a message handler.
